product.name: Collins Super Baggy Jeans
product.description: 5-pocket jeans in rigid cotton denim. Baggy fit from seat to hem with plenty of room around legs. Regular waist, zip fly, and dropped gusset. Rounded legs, stacked at ankle. All you need to conquer the full denim look.

materialDetails.name: Cotton
materialDetails.description: Cotton is a soft and versatile natural fiber harvested from the cotton plant.

materialDetails.name: Polyester
materialDetails.description: Polyester is a synthetic fiber made from crude oil (a fossil resource).

materialDetails.name: Recycled cotton
materialDetails.description: Recycled cotton is cotton made from textile waste in production or from end-of-life textile waste. The waste is mechanically recycled and spun into new yarn.

materialDetails.name: Recycled polyester
materialDetails.description: Recycled polyester is polyester made from PET bottles or end-of-life textile waste. The PET bottles or textile waste is mechanically recycled and processed into new yarn.
